about: The login screen's Sleep, Restart and Shut Down (docs/adr/0064-sleep-restart-shut-down-and-log-out.mdx, decision 8), as a Mac's login window, over logind played on the run's own bus (never the machine's): three buttons at its foot, each named for the assistive technology. The power key asks there too, in the login screen's own dialog (Restart, Sleep, Cancel, Shut Down), never turning the machine off; Cancel asks logind nothing. The foot's Sleep is logind's Suspend, its Shut Down logind's PowerOff, each at once (nobody is signed in: nothing to confirm, no application to ask), not interactive, once. Nobody is ever signed in.
